passages.title: New Sports Centre Opening
passages.text: Hello everyone! I am delighted to announce that the Riverside Sports Centre will finally open its doors to the public next Monday. We have spent months preparing the facilities. If you are interested in swimming, our main pool is 25 metres long and has a special area for children. For those who prefer fitness, the gym is equipped with the latest machines, and we offer a variety of classes including yoga and aerobics. We are currently looking for a receptionist to join our team, so please check our website if you are interested. Membership fees are very reasonable, and if you sign up before the end of the month, you will receive a discount of 15 percent on your first year. We also have a cafe on the ground floor where you can relax after your workout. We look forward to seeing you there!

questions.question: The new sports centre will open on ______.
questions.explanation: The speaker explicitly mentions the centre opens next Monday.

questions.question: The main swimming pool is ______ metres long.
questions.explanation: The transcript states the pool is 25 metres long.

questions.question: The centre is currently looking for a ______ to join the staff.
questions.explanation: The speaker mentions they are looking for a receptionist.

questions.question: New members can get a ______ percent discount if they join early.
questions.explanation: The speaker offers a 15 percent discount for early sign-ups.

questions.question: The discount is available until the end of the ______.
questions.explanation: The transcript specifies the deadline is the end of the month.

questions.question: There is a ______ on the ground floor for people to relax in.
questions.explanation: The speaker mentions a cafe on the ground floor.
